items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: We were great admirers of the Ben Pollack orchestra which at the time had Glenn Miller and Jimmy McPartland and Benny Goodman, particularly.

ctx.x: Back in Detroit we settled down to an easy pace playing six nights a week, Mondays off. I remember one of those times we went out to Chicago on let's see, a Monday. I think they had Sunday night off, that is, they I am speaking of Ben Pollack. We were great admirers of the Ben Pollack orchestra which at the time had Glenn Miller and Jimmy McPartland and Benny Goodman, particularly.
Had you heard them on record?
